```{=html}
<script>
function draw() {
  var canvas = document.getElementById("chevron-canvas");
  if (!canvas) return;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return;

  var offset = 0;
  var direction = 1;
  var globalAlpha = 0;      // for fade-in
  var fadeDone = false;

  function drawChevron(x, y, size, alpha) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - size, y - size/4);   // size/4 instead of size/2 = shallower
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + size/4);
    ctx.lineTo(x + size, y - size/4);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + alpha + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function animate() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Fade in
    if (!fadeDone) {
      globalAlpha = Math.min(1, globalAlpha + 0.02);
      if (globalAlpha >= 1) fadeDone = true;
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = globalAlpha;

    offset += 0.3 * direction;
    if (offset > 8) direction = -1;
    if (offset < 0) direction = 1;

    var cx = canvas.width / 2;

    ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("scroll down", cx, 25);

    drawChevron(cx, 55 + offset, 18, 0.3);
    drawChevron(cx, 85 + offset, 18, 0.6);
    drawChevron(cx, 115 + offset, 18, 1.0);

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  animate();
}

[50,  100, 150].forEach(function(ms) {
  setTimeout(draw, ms);
});
</script>
```
